protocol: Compare identical providers, tiers and total budgets; run each case with seeds a,b,c. Record ALL task outcomes, including failures. Human checks are separate from runtime QA.

cases.prompt: 做一个猫咪收集鱼的小游戏，有一点新意。
checks: 三次设计的玩家决策有区别
